extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change f'(x) of a function f.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Real exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent n that is any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Positive integer exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponent n restricted to positive integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function built from powers of x with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x, including e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x) when c is constant.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A fixed number c.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number with lim_{h→0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural exponential function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e.

extracted_concepts.name: General exponential function a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponential function with base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm ln used in d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: lim_{h→0}(e^h-1)/h=1 defines e.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value approached by an expression as its input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: v(t)=s'(t), the derivative of position.

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The location function s(t) whose derivative is velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t), the derivative of velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Second derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a derivative, written s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: MC=C'(x), the derivative of the cost function.

extracted_concepts.name: Cost function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The economic cost function C(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The interpretation of the derivative as change per unit change.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The line whose slope is given by the derivative at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation.
